regression_slice.method: Exact failure-ID set comparison. The repaired court was run against the UNREPAIRED module to produce the BEFORE set, then against the REPAIRED module to produce the AFTER set, and the two sorted ID sets were compared with comm. The module was file-swapped in place and restoration was verified by sha256 after each swap, because a PYTHONPATH overlay does not shadow the pytest rootdir.

witness_classification_honest_note.discriminating_witnesses: The 15 IDs in before_failing_ids fail on unrepaired code and pass on repaired code. These are the witnesses that carry evidential weight.
witness_classification_honest_note.why_disclosed: These five pass on the unrepaired module as well, by design: W7/W8/W9 are positive controls and W10 is a structural property of the court file itself. They are preservation and anti-vacuity witnesses, not proof that the repair did work. Only the 15 discriminating IDs do that.
